title: Native CLM v0 M3R — Read-Preserving / Lineage-Isolated Growth
scientific_question: Starting from the exact canonical M1 checkpoint and reusing the exact M3 protected-write pressure controller, does immutable-root, lineage-local function-preserving mitosis restore replay-free continual-language retention relative to the matched M3 global-pool growth algorithm?
new_integration_variable: read topology during growth: global dynamic Top-K versus immutable root Top-K plus lineage-local parent-child chain routing

parent_m2.interpretation: certificate-projected Cell writes reduce forgetting, but fixed protected capacity fails absolute A retention

parent_m3.interpretation: global-pool children were created and reused but changed read ownership, worsening old-domain retention

causal_arms.global_growth_control: exact frozen M3 global dynamic Top-K growth algorithm
causal_arms.lineage_growth: same M3 pressure controller, but original eight roots are the only top-level candidates and children compete only inside their root lineage

read_topology.root_router: frozen M1 query projection and original eight route keys only
read_topology.lineage_router: deterministic parent-to-child chain; child replaces parent only when its frozen key has strictly higher cosine score for the current query; ties retain parent
read_topology.gate_mass_rule: root-level probability is conserved and applied to the concrete root/descendant selected inside that lineage
read_topology.claim: new children cannot steal another original root's sparse route slot

growth.note: These numerical thresholds are copied unchanged from frozen M3. M3R does not tune the growth controller.

formal_decision_rule: SUPPORTED only if every formal seed completes and every registered gate is true on every seed
positive_interpretation: Under the registered 12.15M real-language stream, conserving root read ownership and making mitosis function-preserving restores protected continual-language retention beyond the otherwise identical global-pool growth algorithm without learner replay.
next_if_supported: M4 Cell ontology / specialization analysis at the same model scale
next_if_not_supported: freeze M3R negative and diagnose lineage-local functional boundary/selectivity; do not tune or reuse M3R formal seeds
